title: Excellent service throughout
text: Ray at Install Pros has been excellent. I have been kept up to date every step of the way, only dealing with Ray so no need to keep repeating myself. Everything was explained, my queries answered, all followed up with WhatsApp messages and a very short turn around on installation was honoured which was urgently required. The excellent service continued with the prompt arrival of Kevin to complete the installation, who was very patient whilst explaining the set up & didn't leave until I was completely satisfied. I would highly recommend Install Pros to family & friends

title: Amazing Job!!!
text: Today we had our fitting of Starlink. Dan C what a great guy. He arrived and although he had had a long day getting to us for 5.30 he was professional and took his time. He was respectful and really thought through how he was going to fit everything. We live on a houseboat and for the first time in 4 years have internet in the kitchen!!! Dan C set up all of our Sky TV boxes and made sure they were all working before left. What an amazing job in such extreme heat as well!!! Thank you Dan C what a star ⭐
